source_title: ScaleFlux Appoints Greg Ernst as Chief Business Officer to Drive Global Growth in AI Infrastructure - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
Former Intel Chief Revenue Officer brings 27 years of experience and deep relationships across hyperscaler, OEM, and ODM customers
MILPITAS, Calif. , Oct. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- ScaleFlux , a leader in storage and memory silicon solutions for AI infrastructure, today announced the appointment of Greg Ernst as Chief Business Officer ( CBO ). Ernst brings 27 years of experience at Intel, most recently as Chief Revenue Officer and General Manager of the Sales Group.
At ScaleFlux, Ernst will lead global sales, product, marketing, and customer operations. He will drive the company's go-to-market strategy across hyperscaler, neocloud, OEM, and ODM customers as ScaleFlux expands its presence in the AI infrastructure ecosystem.
"AI infrastructure is placing unprecedented demands on memory and storage, and Greg brings extensive industry experience, deep customer relationships, and a proven track record of building high-performing global teams", said Hao Zhong, co-founder, Chairman of the board and CEO of ScaleFlux.
Ernst joined Intel in 1999 and led account teams for four Fortune 100 technology companies and Tier-1 server and storage OEMs. He later served as Vice President in the Sales and Marketing Group and General Manager of U.S. Sales, and as Corporate Vice President and General Manager of the Americas, leading the teams that supported all Americas-based customers and partners.
Throughout his career, Ernst has led global sales organizations and managed strategic relationships with major OEM customers. His focus has been on deepening customer relationships, driving customer and partner success, and building sales and marketing approaches that open new business opportunities. He brings extensive experience in semiconductor sales, business development, and customer engagement to ScaleFlux.
"ScaleFlux offers a unique combination of differentiated silicon, firmware, and a business model that gives customers real supply-chain flexibility," said Ernst. "I'm excited to lead the team as we work with customers to scale their AI data pipelines and unlock the full performance of their data centers."
Ernst's appointment marks an important step in ScaleFlux's continued growth as the company expands its silicon portfolio to address the evolving storage and memory requirements of AI and data center infrastructure.
Founded in 2014, ScaleFlux is a leader in storage and memory silicon solutions for AI infrastructure. The company combines differentiated silicon and firmware, including in-drive transparent data compression, to help customers scale the AI data pipeline, with greater performance, efficiency, and capacity from every watt and every terabyte. ScaleFlux works with hyperscaler, neocloud, OEM, and ODM customers and offers a business model that gives them real supply-chain flexibility. ScaleFlux is headquartered in Milpitas, California.
For more information, visit www.scaleflux.com .
